title: Minecraft Java 1.16.1 Released
author: Adrian Östergård

blocks.source_text: We're now releasing 1.16.1 for Minecraft: Java Edition. This version fixes stability issues with Realms.
blocks.translated_text: 我们现在为 Minecraft: Java版发布了1.16.1版本。此版本解决了Realms模式的稳定性问题。

blocks.source_text: Looking for all the new stuff in the Nether Update release? You can check out [this post](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/nether-update-java) to read about all the new things!
blocks.translated_text: 想了解Nether更新中的所有新内容吗？你可以查看[这篇帖子](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/nether-update-java)来了解更多详情！

blocks.source_text: ​To install the release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/download) and click play! Make sure your Launcher is set to the "Latest Release" option.
blocks.translated_text: 要安装新版本，请打开[Minecraft启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/download)，然后点击‘开始游戏’。确保你的启动器设置为了‘最新版本’选项。
你可以在这里报告漏洞：

blocks.source_text: Head over to our  [feedback website](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)  or come chat with us about it on the  [official Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) .
blocks.translated_text: 请访问我们的 [反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)，或在 [官方 Minecraft Discord 所群](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) 与我们讨论这个问题。

content:
We're now releasing 1.16.1 for Minecraft: Java Edition. This version fixes stability issues with Realms.

Looking for all the new stuff in the Nether Update release? You can check out [this post](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/nether-update-java) to read about all the new things!

GET THE RELEASE

​To install the release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/download) and click play! Make sure your Launcher is set to the "Latest Release" option.

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/a412fd69db1f81db3f511c1463fd304675244077/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker!](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

Want to give feedback?

Head over to our  [feedback website](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)  or come chat with us about it on the  [official Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) .
translated_content:
我们现在为 Minecraft: Java版发布了1.16.1版本。此版本解决了Realms模式的稳定性问题。

想了解Nether更新中的所有新内容吗？你可以查看[这篇帖子](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/nether-update-java)来了解更多详情！

立即下载新版本吧！

要安装新版本，请打开[Minecraft启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/download)，然后点击‘开始游戏’。确保你的启动器设置为了‘最新版本’选项。

跨平台服务器JAR文件：

[Minecraft服务器JAR文件](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/a412fd69db1f81db3f511c1463fd304675244077/server.jar)

你可以在这里报告漏洞：

[Minecraft问题追踪器！](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

想要提供反馈吗？

请访问我们的 [反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)，或在 [官方 Minecraft Discord 所群](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) 与我们讨论这个问题。
